dedupe_keys.name: wake effects when estimating residual life of wind turbine support structures

description: Barahona, Braulio and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented reduced-order formulation combines a coarse wake representation, quasi-static aerodynamics, control, drivetrain and tower states. It estimates fatigue-load trends under the evaluated wind-turbine operating cases. Its computational simplifications support system-level investigations with reduced cost, while statistical agreement in limited cases does not establish detailed transient fidelity. The inspected description does not identify an independently licensed source package or demonstrate every turbine, wind regime or controller. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
